title: Capability schema — Tool Capability Registry (Signature)
description:
Signature edition — an original Signature-authored completion, clearly labeled as Signature work and never presented as public record. The tool capability registry is the yellow pages for the AI's toolbox: a searchable catalog describing what each available tool can do — its verbs, inputs, outputs, costs, and limits. Planners consult it instead of hardcoding tool knowledge, so adding a new tool is a registration, not a code change. Good registrations are honest about limits; a registry full of exaggeration is worse than none.

This record documents the capability schema approach: Define a standard registration shape: verbs, inputs, outputs, preconditions, effects, cost, limits.
